newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GITIC to make general offer for Hualing.
newsitem.headline: GITIC to make general offer for Hualing.

text.p: Hualing Holdings Ltd said on Friday that following a recent rights issue in which Guangzhou International Trust and Investment Corp (GITIC) raised its stake in the company to about 37.49 percent, GITIC was set to make a general offer for the company.

Hualing said in a statement issued through the stock exchange that GITIC's stake in the company has been increased to 37.49 percent of the enlarged share capital from 17.1 percent following completion of a rights share issue.
Hualing said Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has orally informed GITIC that there is an obligation to make a general offer and that a wavier will not be granted.

Subject to receiving the SFC's written ruling, GITIC will procure that a general offer be made, and a further announcement setting out the detailed terms of such general offer will be made once the same have been finalised, Hualing said.
Trading in the shares of the company has been suspended from November 14, pending the issue of the anouncement setting out the terms of the general offer.
Guangzhou International Trust and Investment Corp is supervised by the Guangzhou municipal government.
